description_en: Queries the Layer 7 switches for internal access applications
description_zh: 批量查询内网访问应用七层开关
name: ListPrivateAccessApplicationL7Switches

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the internal access applications. You can specify up to 100 application IDs
parameters.help_zh: 内网访问应用ID集合。最多可输入100个内网访问应用ID
parameters.name: application_ids

ApplicationId.description_en: The ID of the internal access application

DevTagMarkStatus.description_en:
The device tag marking switch. Valid values:
Enabled: Enabled.
Disabled: Disabled
DevTagMarkStatus.description_zh:
设备标签标记开关，取值：
Enabled：开启。
Disabled：关闭

DownloadAuditStatus.description_en:
The sensitive application download audit switch. Valid values:
Enabled: Enabled.
Disabled: Disabled
DownloadAuditStatus.description_zh:
敏感应用下载审计开关。取值：
Enabled：开启。
Disabled：关闭

items.description_en: The start port. Must be less than or equal to the end port
items.description_zh: 起始端口。小于等于结束端口

End.description_en: The end port. Must be greater than or equal to the start port
End.description_zh: 结束端口。大于等于起始端口

SrcIpMarkStatus.description_en:
The source IP marking switch. Valid values:
Enabled: Enabled.
Disabled: Disabled.**
SrcIpMarkStatus.description_zh:
源IP标记开关，取值：
Enabled：开启。
Disabled：关闭。**

Status.description_en:
The status of the internal access policy. Valid values:
Enabled: Enabled.
Disabled: Disabled
Status.description_zh:
内网访问策略状态。取值：
Enabled：开启。
Disabled：关闭

UrlAccessPaths.description_en: The URL access whitelist rules for the application. These rules take effect only when Status is set to Enabled. An empty value indicates that URLs and request methods are not restricted. A request passes the URL check only when the request path and method meet any group of rules at the same time. Otherwise, the request is blocked. Passing the URL check does not allow requests that are already blocked by an access policy
UrlAccessPaths.description_zh: 应用的 URL 访问白名单规则。仅在 Status 为 Enabled 时生效；为空表示不限制 URL 和请求方法。请求路径与方法同时满足任意一组规则时通过 URL 检查，否则阻断；通过 URL 检查不会放行已被访问策略阻断的请求

AllowMethods.description_en: The list of HTTP request methods allowed for the paths in this group. An empty value indicates that request methods are not restricted
AllowMethods.description_zh: 本组路径允许使用的 HTTP 请求方法列表。为空表示不限制请求方法

items.description_en: The allowed HTTP request method. Valid values: GET, HEAD, POST, PUT, DELETE, OPTIONS, and PATCH
items.description_zh: 允许的 HTTP 请求方法。取值：GET、HEAD、POST、PUT、DELETE、OPTIONS、PATCH

Urls.description_en: The list of URL paths allowed for access in this group. The list must contain at least 1 path and up to 20 paths. This parameter matches the path part in the request, excluding the protocol, domain name, and query parameters
Urls.description_zh: 本组允许访问的 URL 路径列表，至少包含 1 个路径，最多 20 个。匹配请求中的路径部分，不包含协议、域名和查询参数

items.description_en: A single URL path or wildcard pattern allowed for access, such as /api/test or /test/. The asterisk () does not match the path separator (/)
items.description_zh: 允许访问的单个 URL 路径或通配符模式。例如 /api/test 或 /test/*；其中 * 不匹配路径分隔符 /

UserMarkStatus.description_en:
The user marking switch. Valid values:
Enabled: Enabled.
Disabled: Disabled
UserMarkStatus.description_zh:
用户标记开关，取值：
Enabled：开启。
Disabled：关闭

ZeroTrustStatus.description_en:
The host anti-bypass switch. Valid values:
Enabled: Enabled.
Disabled: Disabled
ZeroTrustStatus.description_zh:
Host防绕过开关，取值：
Enabled：开启。
Disabled：关闭
